reviewer_role: independent A4 pattern/exam-language reviewer; not the A6 author

findings.title: Semicolon-delimited command observations leave 63 supported command-word pattern links missing
findings.impact: Glossary-to-pattern coverage is incomplete and one no-link disposition is false. Downstream trace and learning metadata would omit observed assessment language.
findings.required_fix: Tokenize accepted semicolon-delimited command observations into exact trimmed command tokens without fuzzy expansion; add all 63 supported pairs and evidence records; change TERM-CW-JUSTIFY to RECONCILED; update the reconciliation delta, QA, manifests and handoff.
findings.required_retest: Fresh independent A4 reviewer must reconstruct command-token membership from the accepted pattern catalog and confirm zero missing or extra command-word pairs across all 504 patterns.

findings.title: Qualifier leakage creates nine unsupported check-digit pattern links

evidence.source_review: Accepted official examples for the nine patterns assess presence/double-entry association or range, format, length, presence and existence validation. None has REQ-6.2-02-07 or source evidence assessing check digit.

findings.impact: The glossary falsely presents sibling validation patterns as check-digit assessment patterns, violating the ban on keyword-only linking and the stated check-digit boundary.
findings.required_fix: Remove the nine pattern IDs and their evidence from TERM-VAL-CHECK-DIGIT. Keep AC26-6.2-02 supported only by the focus-bearing REQ-6.2-02-07 evidence; remove the six qualifier-only objective-evidence records. Update delta, QA, manifests and handoff.
findings.required_retest: Fresh independent A4 reviewer must inspect every corrected check-digit bridge against pattern requirements and official examples and confirm no qualifier-only link remains.

findings.title: Boundary markdown contains control-character escape corruption
findings.impact: The required human-readable terminology-boundary artifact displays damaged labels and cannot be relied on as a clean review record.
findings.required_fix: Regenerate the markdown with literal text and no control characters, preserving the intended boundaries and correcting the output manifest/handoff hashes.
findings.required_retest: Fresh review must scan the corrected UTF-8 bytes for forbidden controls and read every protected-boundary statement.

reviewer_stop: Freeze exactly six outputs in the assigned review directory. Do not edit author inputs, trackers, A0 evidence, split, trace, lessons, app, or Stage 3 artifacts.
